title: Galaxy Z Fold8 duo and Flip8 exceed Samsung's pre-order targets in Europe
description: Samsung unveiled the Galaxy Z Flip8, the Galaxy Z Fold8, and the Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra on July 22, and all three of them will go on sale starting August 7. However, like previous models, these foldables are also currently on pre-order in different regions, and they have exceeded Samsung's pre-order targets in Europe. Not just that, Samsung announced that these three new foldables also surpassed total pre-orders for last year's Galaxy Z Fold7 and Galaxy Z Flip7 by 20% year-on-year in Europe in the first 11 days since their July 22 unveiling, with the Fold8 accounting for almost 40% of the...

title: Samsung showcases fast and efficient BV-NAND V10 storage, zHBM for AI accelerators
description: Samsung is showcasing a great variety of memory and storage technologies at its booth at the Future of Memory and Storage (FMS) 2026 event in Santa Clara, California. Thirteen years after it introduced the first V-NAND technology, Samsung is the first to unveil V10 of BV-NAND (Bonded V-NAND). This is a flash memory that has more than 400 layers and leverages Samsung’s advanced bonding technology to stack memory cells. V10 increases memory density by around 58% compared to the previous V9. The higher layer count gives V10 better read, write and I/O performance. It also improves power...

title: SpaceX aims to enter the US telecom market and challenge AT&T, T-Mobile and Verizon
description: During an investor call on Tuesday, SpaceX announced its plans to build a mobile service network and enter the US market. This will put SpaceX in direct competition with AT&T, T-Mobile and Verizon. SpaceX recently acquired 65 MHz wireless spectrum licenses from EchoStar for $19.6 billion, which will help the company expand its mobile services. And since the spectrum purchased from EchoStar has terrestrial components, "the rocket company" plans to use it to build a network and offer a true mobile service. title: WhatsApp introduces new features for group chats, including the @all tag
description: WhatsApp has announced new features for group chats, including the @all tag, poll deadlines, and the ability to create a new group chat from an existing one. Let's talk about the polls feature first. WhatsApp now allows users to edit the poll questions within 15 minutes and set an end time to lock voting when the time is up. Users can also hide the voter names so group members feel more comfortable sharing their preferences. Next up is the @all tag, which eliminates the need to tag all group members individually in a message to alert them. However, note that for groups with more...

title: Honor adopts new logo and "Dare to Be" slogan, says it grew 25% in the first quarter of 2026
description: Honor is continuing its push to refresh its brand image with a new logo and a new tagline: “Dare to Be”. This isn’t just a new coat of paint, though. Honor wants users to know that it’s more than just a smartphone company. Part of that is the upcoming Robot Phone, which was recently featured in an event with partner Arri (a famous maker of cinema cameras). This device – part phone, part robot – is part of Honor’s efforts to build intelligent devices – adaptive, interactive machines powered by AI. title: This is where you can watch the Redmi Note 17 launch
description: Xiaomi has announced the India launch of the Redmi Note 17 5G, which will be taking place tomorrow, on August 6 at 12:00PM IST. This is an online-only event, and will be live-streamed on YouTube. The Redmi Note 17 5G is the latest in Xiaomi's popular Redmi Note series of phones, and the successor to last year's Redmi Note 15 5G. Key features of this new device include an 8000mAh battery, 120Hz AMOLED display with Corning Gorilla Glass 7i protection, 50MP camera on the back, and finally the Qualcomm Snapdragon 4 Gen 4 chipset. The phone should go on sale some time later this...

title: Huawei nova 16 SE debuts with an 8,500mAh battery and 6.84-inch display
description: As promised, Huawei has officially unveiled the latest addition to its nova 16 series in China. The nova 16 SE packs a large 8,500mAh battery and comes with a bright display with a claimed 8,000 nits peak brightness. The Huawei nova 16 SE features a 6.84-inch AMOLED display with a 120Hz refresh rate. It is powered by the Kirin 8020 chipset and is available with up to 512GB of onboard storage. title: Realme 16x India launch set for next week, 7,000mAh battery confirmed
description: Rumors surfaced late last month that the Realme 16x would soon launch in India. Realme has now confirmed when the smartphone will make its debut. The Realme 16x will launch in India on August 12. The company has also listed the smartphone on its official India website, revealing several of its key specifications. Realme has confirmed that the Indian variant will pack a 7,000mAh battery with support for 45W fast charging. description: Back in July, we heard from Digital Chat Station on Weibo that the 20th anniversary iPhone Pro Max (which we'll just call iPhone 20 Pro Max for simplicity) will have a 7-inch screen, slightly larger than the iPhone 17 Pro Max's 6.9-inch panel. title: iQOO Z11 confirmed to debut in India on August 20
description: The iQOO Z11 debuted in China in March before expanding to select global markets in May. Several months later, the smartphone is finally headed to India, albeit with a different design and hardware. In a post on X, the company confirmed that the iQOO Z11 will launch in India on August 20. The company also revealed the phone's design, which differs significantly from the Chinese and Malaysian variants. The Indian Z11 features a Pixel-style horizontal camera bar housing dual rear cameras and an LED flash, replacing the camera module seen on the other versions. The Indian variant...

description: Indian handset maker Lava is set to make its UK debut soon with the Agni 4N, which it has been teasing for over a week now by taking constant digs at Samsung. The brand has posted one more teaser, which is yet another dig at the South Korean company. The teaser video posted by Lava UK on its X account gives us a glimpse of the Lava Agni 4N while also confirming the metal build. The smartphone has a horizontally aligned camera island on the rear like the Agni 4, with the right side frame featuring the volume rocker and power button. description: Redmi has revealed more details about the K100 Pro ahead of its launch next week. The company has already confirmed that the handset will be powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 V chipset and feature a 6.59-inch display. In a new post on Weibo, Redmi confirmed that the K100 Pro will feature a triple rear camera setup headlined by a 200MP primary sensor with OIS. The rear camera system will also include an ultrawide camera and a telephoto sensor with support for 10cm macro photography. description: Technically, Google only releases one major Android version per year – this year it was Android 17. Yesterday, Google rolled out Android 17 QPR 1 Beta 8 to Pixels and now Android QPR 2 Beta 2. Strangely, the release notes make no mention of what has changed since QPR 2 Beta 1. title: Nothing launches CMF Clip Pro earbuds with a Smart Dial on the case
description: Just as expected, today Nothing has unveiled the CMF Clip Pro earbuds. As the name implies, these are clip-style or clip-on earbuds, a category that didn't exist a few years ago but has been gaining popularity recently. These have 10.8mm drivers with "Ultra Bass Technology", and the company advertises 10 hours of music playback and 6.5 hours of talk time from each bud's 60mAh battery. description: Yesterday we heard that Oppo is already working on the F35 family, which would be launching in India in the next few weeks. Today a new rumor from the same source claims that the series is actually getting official before the end of this month. While it's still unclear how many members the F35 family will have, new details about the F35 Pro have emerged. Apparently, it will be a rebranded A7 Pro Max, which just launched in China today. description: The ZTE Blade A35 launched all the way back in 2024, which is also when a Blade A35e was spotted in a certification listing. We're not sure what's happened to it since then, but now a Blade A35e that looks very different has appeared on ZTE's official website for Pakistan. title: Amazon Prime Video will support Samsung's HDR10+ Advanced
description: Amazon's Prime Video streaming service will be the first one to use Samsung's newest HDR10+ Advanced format on "supported titles globally" beginning later this month. You will need a Samsung TV from the Korean company’s 2026 lineup to take advantage of the new format. As the name implies, HDR10+ Advanced is an upgrade to the HDR10+ format. title: Google Health finally supports two-way health data syncing with Apple Health
description: When Google launched its new Fitbit Air devices, the company announced a somewhat surprising new feature that lets you import Apple Health data recorded by your Apple Watch and other HealthKit-connected apps and devices. A long-requested feature since 2014 when Apple Health first launched. However, syncing your data the other way remained impossible until now. With the new version of Google Health for iOS (5.05), your Fitbit data can finally be stored in your Apple Health account. Two-way syncing is finally a thing. description: Good night, sweet prince – OnePlus is officially out of the US market. On July 16, the company made the initial announcement that it will be exiting the North American and European markets. And now the last OnePlus phone has been sold via oneplus.com. The OnePlus 15 and OnePlus 15R are both out of stock on the official site. The site is now pretty barren – there are no more tablets, no smartwatches either.
